Content inside <template> is never rendered per the HTML spec and must not appear in the output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p>visible</p><template><p>secret template text</p></template><p>also visible</p>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result)

main()
```
